meta.title: teeTIM // natural fiber ... artificial design
meta.desc: Home page of the 100% Quebec-made clothing designer, created by TIM students using AI-generated designs and made with 100% natural and organic fibers.

accueil.amorceH1: T-shirts, hoodies, and caps made in Quebec 💯
accueil.amorceH4: /** with a little help from DALL-E 😉 **/
accueil.para1: Today, the T-shirt is an essential garment in everyone's wardrobe. And with environmental concerns more important than ever, Quebec-made T-shirts are preferred to reduce environmental impact and highlight local craftsmanship.
accueil.para2: V-neck, crew neck, loose or fitted, short-sleeve or long-sleeve for the chillier ones, plain or patterned to style an outfit... The T-shirt is available in a variety of colors, styles, and patterns.
